items: Tang Manor gates, walls, water, fire response, granaries, patrols, medical care, stable care, and routine administration perform lawful routine work within delegated limits.
House Tang covenant prevents outside service and hostile defection.
Tang Forge never sells restricted equipment or methods outside.
Sword Manor does not train outsiders for money.
Routine caravan screening may begin under gate authority, but exceptional cargo, identity, custody, security, payment, or contract questions escalate.
Irreversible political, military, financial, family, contract, appointment, property, or combat choices stop for Tang Wei unless already covered by saved authority.
records.label: Standing orders
